taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-07 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1790.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 384.0 | 1.63 | 2.15
3 | 73.0 | 22.70 | 24.85
4 | 103.4 | 11.48 | 36.33
5 | 540.2 | 1.37 | 37.70
6 | 520.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-07
Curve type: QHAA-type
Aquifer depth: 2.15 – 36.33 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of 38 to 40 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity saturated weathered zone into the competent underlying formation. Install casing with well screens across the optimum water-bearing zone between 2.2 m and 36.3 m.
